node.statement: Scope and dependency bridge: require validated node 1.3.2.1 and assume e:=rho+epsilon<e_bridge:=min{1,e_hom,e_mod}. Only under this hypothesis invoke that node to obtain b_n<=5 and ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)-gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||<=D e||X||^2. Then (1-epsilon)b_n^2<=b_n+D e. If b_n<=1 the claimed bound follows from e>=0; if b_n>1, epsilon<=e and b_n<=5 imply b_n(b_n-1)<=epsilon b_n^2+D e<=(25+D)e, so division by b_n>=1 yields b_n<=1+(25+D)e. No assertion is made for e>=e_bridge.
